rationale.conceptual: The method is the paper's own custom DFT-continuum approach (ESM-RISM) requiring genuine understanding of grand-canonical DFT, electrochemical double-layer structure, free energy corrections, and how to set up calculations for different adsorption sites and electrolyte compositions. It involves several interacting theoretical components (electronic grand potential, vibrational entropy, solvation free energy) that must be correctly combined.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of multiple fragile stages: installing Quantum ESPRESSO with ESM-RISM and BEEF-vdw functional, constructing input models, running up to ~40 independent DFT calculations with different parameters, extracting grand potentials, computing vibrational frequencies for each adsorbate configuration, applying thermodynamic corrections, and assembling the final CSV. Managing so many DFT jobs with correct convergence is non-trivial.
